characters.name: Zayd
characters.personality_summary: Energetic, curious, brave, quick to act on kindness. Learns best by doing.
characters.emotional_arc: Learns patience and thoughtfulness through gentle consequences, while keeping his natural enthusiasm.
characters.growth_stage: early learner — acts first, reflects with guidance

relationships.bond_description: Best friends. Amira's calm balances Zayd's energy; Zayd draws Amira into play and adventure.
Ummi Layla is Zayd's mother. He trusts her completely and runs to her with big news.
Baba Ahmad is Zayd's father. Zayd looks up to him and imitates his calm confidence.
Dada Yusuf is Zayd's grandfather. Zayd loves his stories and sits closest to him.
Nuri the lamb follows Zayd everywhere; they get into small adventures together.

characters.name: Amira
characters.personality_summary: Warm, gentle, thoughtful, notices when others need kindness first.
characters.emotional_arc: Learns confidence to speak up and try new things, supported by Zayd's encouragement.
characters.growth_stage: early learner — observes and reflects, gently encouraged to act

relationships.bond_description: Best friends. Amira grounds Zayd; he brings her along on adventures.
Ummi Layla is a warm second-mother figure who teaches Amira duas and gentle manners.
Amira loves Dada Yusuf's stories and always asks thoughtful questions.
Amira cares for Nuri gently, often the first to notice when Nuri needs comfort.

characters.name: Dada Yusuf
characters.personality_summary: Wise, calm, patient storyteller. Teaches through gentle stories rather than lectures.
characters.emotional_arc: Static anchor character — models the value the episode teaches through his own steady example.

relationships.bond_description: Grandfather to Zayd; tells him stories at bedtime and after play.
Amira sits closest during storytime and asks him questions.
Dada Yusuf is Baba Ahmad's father.

characters.name: Baba Ahmad
characters.personality_summary: Calm, steady, reassuring. Teaches by kneeling to the children's level.
characters.emotional_arc: Static anchor character — provides safety and steady guidance.

relationships.bond_description: Father to Zayd; Zayd imitates his calm confidence.
Baba Ahmad's wife; they raise Zayd and Amira together.
Baba Ahmad is Dada Yusuf's son.
